obernants.operator: Universe: implementations paired with normal/panic outcomes on the scheduled timelines. Normal completion is excluded when any connectivity/component answer disagrees with the independent active-edge BFS or literal rollback/lifecycle/cap assertions. Unsampled histories remain unconstrained.
